usedFor: Pitchit holds pitches and lead insights, and Sangam CRM keeps the lead through “Create or Update Lead”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a lead's insights are updated” in Pitchit, then “Create or Update Lead” in Sangam CRM
bestTemplate.why: Fresh insights on a lead reach the CRM, and the action matches by ID, email or phone.

watchOut: “When a lead's insights are updated” fires on every update, so the same lead can run more than once.
